summary: American Water Works Company, Inc. filed an amendment (Form 8-K/A) to correct an XBRL date tag error in its original 8-K. The underlying event is a routine rate-case filing by subsidiary Missouri-American Water with the Missouri Public Service Commission, seeking ~$179M in incremental annual revenue based on $1.6B of capital investments, a 10.50% ROE, and a 50.3% equity capital structure. This is a regulatory proceeding, not a special situation. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisors are involved. The filing is a standard operational update; no risk-arb angle exists.
